Median of N with spread is the REPORTER's reduction.

min_width.description: minimum length in bytes of a match for the pattern (Hyperscan's own capability probe unique to this roster's engine, docs/dev/research/2026-09-12-b42-engine-landscape.md's finding (6))

unordered_matches.description: 1 iff this expression can produce matches not returned in scan order (e.g. from assertions); 0/1 boolean stored as an integer
